templates.why_chosen: Double-column layout centers a literal circular free-list ring (Head/Tail, entries, null) inside the MN's Free MW Queue, with five circled steps and a dashed chain (MWTable to MW to Memory Chunk) crossing the CN/MN boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a ring buffer or free list as an actual circle with Head/Tail arrows and a null slot rather than a generic queue box, chain each table entry to its resource with a dashed indirection arrow, and number the steps so they cross the host/device boundary through explicit NIC boxes on both sides.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence nested-stack exemplar spanning a host-device split: the CN side nests its API box inside a runtime box, while the MN side nests a ring buffer and an MWTable, tied together by 5 numbered steps.
templates.what_to_learn: Nest a paper's own small contribution box one level inside its host's generic runtime box rather than drawing it as a sibling, and represent an internal data structure like a free list literally as a ring with Head and Tail pointers instead of a plain rectangle.
